The '''Raid on the ''Research'' convoy''' was a battle fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] near the [[XQ6 Platform]] ''[[Research]]'', in the [[Parmic system/Legends|Parmic system]].

==Prelude==
With the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototypes safely being delivered to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] despite [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Battle of Vinzen Neela 5|interference]] at [[Vinzen Neela 5]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] could now proceed with his new beam weapon that would be installed on a starfighter. Believing that there was still a spy in his station he took no chances and had an [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] squadron, one of which piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] ready to rendezvous with the convoy.

==Battle==
The convoy consisting of two [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] ''[[Anterab]]'' and ''[[Degathem]]'' escorted by [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttle]], ''[[Omicron 5]]'' arrived to deliver the shipment to freighter [[Docking Plt]]. Soon afterwards 6 [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] arrived and the Gunboats engaged. However, 5 [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and two [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault transports]] [[Storm Unit (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|''Storm'']] carrying [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] arrived with the intention of disabling and capturing the freighters.

The station personnel then discovered that the ''B-wings'' were using a [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|new]] type of [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]]. wanting to examine it they ordered Maarek Stele to disable one of the B-wings, Stele complied and succeeded in disabling one of them so that [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] ''[[U3f14]]'' could be launched and bring it to ''[[Research]]''. While this happened the Rebels managed to disable freighter ''Anterab''. However, Stele, with the help of his fellow pilots managed to defeated the Rebel assault, destroying both transports and eliminating both starfighter squadrons.

When the commotion died down [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transport]] ''[[U-3f7]]'' arrived to repair the disabled freighter, and Heavy Lifter docked with the disabled B-wing to take it back to ''Research''. Soon 3 [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] arrived but were destroyed quickly before they could do any damage.

==Aftermath==
The Rebel's element of surprise with the Mag Pulse warhead was lost. Zaarin's research team studied the B-wing's warheads and discovered that they were developed by [[Galactic Electronics]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. This was considered [[Treason/Legends|Treason]] and Zaarin decided to [[Battle of Pondut|capture]] it.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears in the [[1994]] PC game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter''. It is Battle 6 mission 3.
